metamodel.name: ForeACT Forecast Assurance Metamodel
metamodel.intent: Single-source Ecore metamodel for forecast-change actionability assessment.

conformance_rules.name: Forecast version alignment
conformance_rules.description: Selected baseline and current forecast versions must be aligned over the same forecast horizon and target variables.
conformance_rules.rationale: Variance between forecast versions is meaningful only when both versions refer to the same future period.

conformance_rules.name: Target coverage
conformance_rules.description: Every field with role=target must produce a VarianceSignal and VolatilitySignal for the selected analysis period.
conformance_rules.rationale: A decision card is not meaningful unless each selected target is connected to interpretable signals.

conformance_rules.name: Semantic metadata completeness
conformance_rules.description: Decision-relevant fields should have a business name, unit, semantic type, and direction.
conformance_rules.rationale: The tool should not treat columns as anonymous numbers; modelers must make their semantics explicit.

conformance_rules.name: Method declaration
conformance_rules.description: Variance and volatility methods must be explicitly selected or defined before analysis.
conformance_rules.rationale: Interpretability requires a named computation procedure, not hidden calculations.

conformance_rules.name: Transformation traceability
conformance_rules.description: DecisionCards must trace to DatasetVersion, FieldModel, AnalysisScope, MethodSet, ForecastComparisonModel, and SignalModel.
conformance_rules.rationale: The user must be able to inspect why a recommendation was produced and which transformation produced it.

conformance_rules.name: Metamodel extensibility
conformance_rules.description: User-defined concepts must have a name, kind, description, and declared connection to an existing concept.
conformance_rules.rationale: A modeling workbench should allow domain concepts to be introduced without changing code.

transformations.name: ProfileToFieldModel
transformations.purpose: Convert raw CSV columns into typed, editable semantic fields.

transformations.name: ScopeBindingAndVersionAlignment
transformations.purpose: Join baseline and current forecast versions for the same forecast horizon and targets.

transformations.name: MethodSetToSignalModel
transformations.purpose: Apply declared variance and volatility methods rather than hidden calculations.

transformations.name: SignalModelToDecisionCard
transformations.purpose: Transform classified signals into traceable actionability recommendations.
